BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[325F.983] ACCEPTANCE OF CASH REQUIRED. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Definitions.+]

[+(a) For purposes of this section, the following terms have the meanings given. +]

[+(b) "Cash" means the physical currency of the United States, whether paper money or coins. +]

[+(c) "Retail establishment" means a place of business open to the general public for the sale of goods or services. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Requirement.+]

[+A retail establishment is required to accept cash from consumers as payment for goods or services. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective August 1, 2026, and applies to sales of goods and services on or after that date. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to consumer protection; requiring retail establishments to accept cash as payment; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 325F.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[325F.983] ACCEPTANCE OF CASH REQUIRED.

Subdivision 1.

Definitions.

(a) For purposes of this section, the following terms have the meanings given.

(b) "Cash" means the physical currency of the United States, whether paper money or coins.

(c) "Retail establishment" means a place of business open to the general public for the sale of goods or services.

Subd. 2.

Requirement.

A retail establishment is required to accept cash from consumers as payment for goods or services.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective August 1, 2026, and applies to sales of goods and services on or after that date.
additions: (a) For purposes of this section, the following terms have the meanings given.
(b) "Cash" means the physical currency of the United States, whether paper money or coins.
(c) "Retail establishment" means a place of business open to the general public for the sale of goods or services.
A retail establishment is required to accept cash from consumers as payment for goods or services.
This section is effective August 1, 2026, and applies to sales of goods and services on or after that date.
